mentions.name: Tribal Trouble
mentions.description: An open-source modernization of Tribal Trouble, the classic 2004 Java RTS game, ported to modern OpenGL and Java while preserving the original's clean design; built over three months as a retirement project to learn OpenGL and 3D game programming.
mentions.source_excerpt: My retirement treat was to spend three months learning OpenGL and 3D game programming by porting a classic Java RTS game, Tribal Trouble, to more modern OpenGL and Java.
